revision: Range-matched residual PPO, candidate action scale only
training_start: scratch, no warm start or best-checkpoint selection
unchanged: Survival-v2 reward, normalized [-1,1] action space, state observations/Kalman estimator, corrected R100 LQR, random sine training distribution, Fiala plant, actuator, 8 environments, PPO hyperparameters [64,64], lr3e-4, 125 rollout steps, batch200, epochs10, gamma.99, GAE.95, initial log_std=-2, fixed one-million-step budget.
gate: Unchanged revision2/gating.py and development freeze (20 steps, .01 margin). Training is standalone residual, not gate-in-the-loop. .08 is the candidate correction cap before fusion; effective authority still varies. Same normalized exploration now has smaller physical steering variance.
evaluation: Reuse unchanged revision2 episode physics/scenarios and gate, with fresh paired noise; RangeMappedPolicy supplies action*.16 to existing .5-rad boundary. legacy_gated retains historical .5 then gate clipping; legacy_rescaled_gated uses old weights with new .08 scaling to distinguish retraining from merely rescaling. matched_ungated removes performance gate but retains the inherited age decay.
primary: matched_gated minus legacy_gated seed-mean penalized RMSE per region; also report LQR and legacy_rescaled_gated comparisons. All six regions and all five methods, survival and activation. Aggregate speeds/paths within each of five seeds. Descriptive t(4) 95% intervals, no multiplicity-adjusted significance claims. Nominal preservation vs LQR <=2% increase/no survival loss. Improvement requires all five paired means negative and no survival loss; clear advantage additionally >=5% mean reduction. Severe-delay gated traces must equal LQR.
native_smoke: One 20m/s DLC220 run for each new policy seed, noise base3910000, nominal contact, zero added delay, existing real worker with explicit .08 output adapter and frozen gate. Interface/range check only, not a paired native improvement campaign.
limits: No gate-aware reward attribution or mismatch/latency training curriculum added. Same path geometries and five training seeds, fresh test noise. Native performance campaign remains separate; do not claim improved driving solely from smaller action range. Preserve all old models/evidence; no post-test tuning.
